review_candidates.description: United Kingdom (Remote) Ref: TTN001 Reporting to: Team Lead – ADHD Titration Service Remuneration: £61,000 per annum FTE plus £1,000 per annum - working from home allowance Contract Type: Employed | Permanent | Full/ Part-Time – minimum 30 hours per week Location: Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required About Us Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care. A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time or part-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference. A career as an ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber with Psychiatry UK offers: Work for a clinically excellent organisation: Join a team recognised for high standards and innovation, delivering care that truly makes a difference. Manageable caseloads: Focus on quality care without burnout, ensuring you can see the impact of your work. Flexibility and work-life balance: Tailor your role to suit your lifestyle with remote, full-time or part-time (minimum of 30 hours) options, between 8am and 8pm, Monday-Friday (only) Career development opportunities: Access structured training, mentorship, and clear pathways for progression. A sense of belonging and community: Work with a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive team where your contributions are valued. At Psychiatry UK, your work will not only be rewarding professionally but also personally—you’ll be happy, supported, and making a difference every day. The ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber plays a critical role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered care within Psychiatry UK’s ADHD service. Reporting into the Titration Team Lead and working closely with Consultant Psychiatrists, this position is responsible for the treatment and ongoing management of adults with ADHD, including the independent or supplementary prescribing of ADHD medications in line with national guidelines and Psychiatry UK’s clinical policies. The ADHD Specialist Independent Prescribers exercise autonomous clinical judgment to initiate, titrate and monitor treatment efficacy, manage risk, and ensure safe and effective titration, while maintaining professional and ethical standards of care. Through collaborative, multidisciplinary working, they contribute to continuous service development, clinical governance, and quality improvement initiatives, supporting Psychiatry UK’s commitment to innovation and excellence in mental health care. This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), though occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK. As An ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber, You Will Provide safe, effective, and evidence-based prescribing for adult ADHD patients in line with NICE guidelines, Psychiatry UK clinical policies, and the Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS) Prescribing Framework. Manage a defined caseload of patients during the titration and ongoing treatment phases, ensuring timely review of treatment effectiveness, side effects, and adherence. Communicate with patients through Psychiatry UK’s secure portal, offering clear, supportive, and clinically appropriate responses to medication-related queries. Complete End of Titration Reviews (EOTRs) and conduct annual medication reviews in a timely and thorough manner, ensuring continuity and quality of care. Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights within scope of practice, recognising limitations and seeking clinical advice when necessary. Collaborate closely with Consultant Psychiatrists and the wider ADHD service team to ensure coordinated, patient-centred care. Undertake regular risk assessments and review safeguarding concerns, escalating appropriately in line with organisational policy. Maintain accurate, detailed, and confidential clinical records using Psychiatry UK’s digital systems in accordance with professional and legal standards. Participate in audits, quality improvement activities, and the review of prescribing practices to support clinical governance and service development. Engage in regular clinical supervision and team learning to maintain high standards of clinical decision-making. Contribute to the ongoing refinement of Psychiatry UK’s prescribing pathways, titration protocols, and service delivery processes. Remain up to date with relevant legislation, prescribing guidance, and Psychiatry UK policies, with a commitment to continuous professional development. To succeed as an ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber, you will have: Sound clinical experience in the initiation, titration, and management of ADHD in adults. You will demonstrate a strong patient-centred approach, showing empathy, professionalism, and the ability to build rapport with patients and colleagues. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential, with the capacity to engage effectively both remotely and in writing, while collaborating seamlessly within multidisciplinary or multi-agency teams. You will be familiar with ADHD rating scales, validated screening, and monitoring tools, and have a solid awareness of safeguarding procedures, particularly in the context of remote or digital healthcare delivery. A sound understanding of legislation, professional standards, and current developments in ADHD service provision and prescribing practice is required. You will be able to work autonomously, managing an independent caseload efficiently and responsibly, supported by advanced IT and digital literacy skills necessary for confident use of digital health platforms. Registered Nurses Essential Qualifications and Experience: First-level registered Mental Health nurse (RMN) or First-level registered nurse (Adult Nurse/Children’s Nurse/Learning Disabilities Nurse) (with one year post qualification Secondary Mental Health service experience or further Mental Health qualification). Must have Independent & Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification with 1-year post-prescribing qualification experience. 1-year post prescribing qualification experience in Specialist ADHD Service. (Specialist ADHD experience can include working within private and/or NHS Secondary mental health practice) or equivalent. ADHD experience must include managing ADHD patients with prescribing responsibilities, including medication initiation, titration, review, and long-term management. Desirable Qualifications And Experience Further relevant training or qualifications in mental health or neurodevelopmental conditions. Previous experience specifically within ADHD specialist services. Experience in remote clinical service provision or digital healthcare environments. Desirable Knowledge And Skills Experience with titration and long-term management of stimulant and non-stimulant ADHD medications. Understanding of clinical governance, audit, and quality improvement processes related to prescribing. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technology-enabled clinical environment. Knowledge of safeguarding procedures and risk assessment in mental health and remote care settings. Ability to adapt and contribute to service development in a growing, evolving organisation. Psychiatry UK: Supporting You Benefits We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. You’ll have access to a range of wellbeing perks, including: Health Cash Plan and Wellbeing Hub subscription Employee Assistance Programme Annual Volunteering Day Enhanced Sickness and Family Leave pay Length of Service Bonus Work from Home allowance Pension options At Psychiatry UK, we care about what matters to you and provide an environment where you can thrive, professionally and personally. Recruitment Process At Psychiatry UK, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If at any point you require any reasonable adjustments —such as additional time, assistive technology, or an alternative format for materials—please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs to ensure you have a fair and comfortable experience. If this opportunity excites you, why not apply today? We review applications as they come in and may close the advert early if we receive a high volume of interest. To ensure you don’t miss out, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Psychiatry UK is the UK's leading provider of digital psychiatry services, providing assessment, diagnosis, and treatment for a range of mental health conditions. All of the online services have accessibility and convenience at their heart, ensuring everyone can easily and quickly access the care they need.

review_candidates.title: 项目管理部负责人
review_candidates.company: 名气家(深圳)信息服务有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 一、主要职责 全面负责项目管理部的组织管理和专业工作，建立并运行数智化研发中心项目管理体系，对重点项目和多个并行项目实施全过程治理，推动项目目标、范围、计划、资源、质量、成本和风险透明可控。 通过统一规则、过程监督、风险预警、跨部门协调和管理报告，提升项目交付的确定性与组织协同效率。按照公司经营管理优先级，首先保障平台稳定、重点项目交付、AI提效和业务创新落地，同时兼顾数智化研发中心市场化项目的收入、成本、回款和盈利目标。 1. 部门管理与体系建设 1.全面负责项目管理部工作，制定部门年度目标、重点任务和工作计划，做好工作分配、过程指导、绩效评价和能力培养。 2.牵头建立并持续优化数智化项目管理制度、流程、模板和工具，统一项目立项、计划、执行、变更、验收、结项及复盘等关键环节的管理要求。 3.针对内部公共平台、业务赋能、城市公司和外部经营等不同类型项目，制定差异化管理标准。 4.推动项目管理机制在产品、研发、测试、运维、实施、客户服务和市场等团队落地，并持续检查和改进执行效果。 2. 多项目统筹与重点项目治理 1.建立并维护数智化研发中心项目清单和重点项目清单，形成统一、准确的项目管理视图。 2.跟踪各项目的目标、范围、里程碑、资源投入、交付质量、成本和经营结果，对重点项目开展定期健康度评估。 3.识别项目之间的资源冲突、交付依赖和排期矛盾，组织跨部门协调，对重大问题及时预警和升级。 4.对项目实施分级管理，将项目管理资源优先投入重大、高风险和跨部门项目。 5.定期向数智化研发中心负责人及相关管理层报告项目整体运行情况、重大风险和管理建议，为管理决策提供依据。 3. 项目过程、需求变更与风险管理 1.检查项目目标、范围、计划、资源和验收标准的完整性及可执行性，跟踪关键里程碑和承诺事项落实。 2.建立项目风险、问题、依赖、决策和行动项台账，推动责任人、解决措施和完成时限明确并闭环。 3.对需求承接、评估、排期和变更过程实施规范管理，确保重大变更有依据、有评估、有审批、有记录。 4.监督需求变更对工期、资源、成本、质量和商务结果的影响得到充分评估，推动跨专业信息及时汇总和移交。 5.组织重大项目阶段评审、上线准备检查、验收检查和项目复盘，推动项目问题转化为流程、机制和组织能力改进。 6.协同质量、安全和运维等专业团队，将必要的控制要求纳入项目生命周期。 4. 经营协同与项目管理能力建设 1.对外部客户项目建立覆盖合同范围、交付计划、验收、开票、应收、回款及供应商结算触发的协同管理视图。 2.配合市场、财务、实施及项目负责人识别交付与商务流程脱节风险，跟踪项目收入、成本、毛利和回款情况。 3.指导项目负责人及项目骨干制定计划、管理风险、组织协同和开展项目复盘。 4.建立项目负责人工作规范和能力提升机制，沉淀典型案例、模板、检查清单和实践。 5.推动项目数据标准化和管理工具应用，持续提升项目管理的数字化、自动化水平。 6.完成数智化研发中心负责人交办的其他相关工作。 二、任职要求 1. 基本条件与专业能力 1.本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息管理、项目管理或工商管理等相关专业优先。 2.具有5年以上项目管理工作经验，以及项目管理部门、PMO或复杂项目统筹管理经验；具备团队管理能力。 3.具有软件研发、企业数字化、平台产品或大型信息化项目背景，熟悉软件项目全生命周期及敏捷、传统或混合项目管理模式。 4.掌握范围、进度、成本、质量、风险和变更管理方法，能够建立项目管理体系并推动制度、流程、模板和工具落地。 5.具备多项目统筹、数据分析和风险识别能力，能够处理资源冲突、需求变化和跨部门意见分歧。 6.具备良好的问题分析、会议组织、书面表达和管理汇报能力，能够独立推动复杂问题闭环。 2. 优先条件 1.持有PMP、PRINCE2、软考项目管理类证书或同等专业认证。 2.具有项目管理体系建设或管理机制从零到一落地经验。 3.具有企业级SaaS、平台产品、燃气行业、城市公司协同或多法人组织项目经验。 4.具有外部客户项目、合同交付、验收回款或项目经营分析经验。 5.具有AI项目、数据平台或智能化应用项目管理经验。 3. 核心素质要求 1.结果导向与责任意识：不止于发现和汇报问题，能够持续推动责任、措施和时限闭环。 2.系统思维与风险意识：能够从项目个案中识别流程和机制问题，提前发现交付、经营、客户及安全风险。 3.沟通协调与影响力：能够理解不同团队的实际情况，通过事实、规则和有效沟通推动跨部门协同。 4.客观公正与团队领导力：能够如实反映项目状态，坚持原则、把握责任边界，并带领团队形成稳定、专业的产出。
